mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 8.

A national protest against the killing of women continues in Pristina, with demonstrators gathering at Zahir Pajaziti square from 4 p.m. demanding justice for Arlinda.

Kosovo's mayor of Pristina, Përparim Rama, is scheduled to be interviewed today at 1:30 p.m. by the Special Prosecutor's Office as a suspect in an ongoing investigation.

Prime Minister Albin Kurti has accepted the resignation of Gazmend Hoxha, who will step down as Director General of the Kosovo Police.

Lionel Messi, now 39, said he still has much to give Inter Miami and has no plans to return to his former club Newell's Old Boys.

Macedonian authorities conducted a five-hour traffic check on cargo vehicles, finding 101 violations across the country on October 28.
